purpose: Test whether witness independence in data/ depends not only on physical/failure-domain separation but also on the complete prior history available before each later witness.

observed_operator: connections feed upward into recursive map
history of prior observation is part of the map
multiplicity and stopping depend on prior history
later evidence can depend on earlier transcript
PRE_RETURN view defines available prior information
independent future requires conditional min-entropy relative to that view
bootstrap must be separated from independent future
external anchor freezes the prior state
external verifier must not import claimant verifier
chronology and permissions are part of independence evidence

new_connections.name: TEMPORAL_WITNESS_SEPARATION
new_connections.finding: Independence of later evidence cannot be characterized only by hardware/process separation; later witness can inherit information through prior transcript.

new_connections.name: HISTORY_IS_A_SHARED_STATE_CARRIER
new_connections.finding: A public transcript, witness ledger, or recursively updated state can act as a shared carrier even when physical sources are otherwise independent.

new_connections.name: INDEPENDENCE_REQUIRES_PRETARGET_HISTORY_CONDITIONING
new_connections.pattern: P(T_i | complete_history) rather than P(T_i) governs later-witness validity
new_connections.finding: The data explicitly distinguish marginal fairness from history-wise conditional unpredictability.

new_connections.name: EXTERNALIZATION_IS_TEMPORAL_NOT_ONLY_PHYSICAL
new_connections.finding: The external anchor must be established before the later information-bearing event, not merely stored on a different machine afterward.

new_connections.name: RECURSIVE_OBSERVATION_CAN_CREATE_SELF_CONFIRMATION
new_connections.pattern: A observes B -> history records A/B -> A_2 adapts to history -> A_2 appears to confirm A
new_connections.finding: A recursive observatory can manufacture apparent agreement unless the history pathway itself is blinded or included in the null model.

REWIRED.basis: Not executed. Proposed intervention: temporal-edge permutation preserving counts, schema, timestamp marginals and witness count while severing predecessor-to-successor history links.

MATCHED_NULL.basis: Not executed. Proposed null: schema-preserving temporal dependency randomization.

break: which prior event is visible before later witness
which candidate was selected after prior failure
which history branch controls later target choice

matched_null_design.rule: Randomly permute predecessor links within matched strata while preserving timestamps, counts and field distributions.
matched_null_design.purpose: Estimate how often the temporal operator appears because the JSON schema itself contains ordered records.

next_batch_protocol.goal: Execute temporal-edge rewiring and matched-null comparison on the strongest witness/history candidates.
next_batch_protocol.promotion_rule: Do not promote without observed relation-specific collapse under preserved-background rewiring.
